title: GTA6 and Black Friday: Sony and Microsoft Warn of Console Shortages
description: Sony and Microsoft are issuing warnings about console shortages ahead of GTA 6 and Black Friday. Check out the current PS5 and Xbox inventory status.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Console Shortage Warnings Ahead of GTA 6 and Black Friday

As the gaming community eagerly anticipates the arrival of GTA 6, a new challenge is emerging in the hardware market. According to recent reports from IGN Games, both Sony and Microsoft have issued warnings regarding potential console shortages ahead of the upcoming Black Friday shopping season and the anticipated release of GTA 6.

## Current Inventory Status and Market Pressure

Holiday shopping seasons traditionally drive a massive surge in demand for gaming hardware, but this year presents a unique combination of pressures. Industry observers note that the looming presence of GTA 6 is likely accelerating consumer demand for hardware upgrades, putting an unprecedented strain on supply chains. 

As retail inventories fluctuate, consumers are asking a critical question: which PlayStation 5 and Xbox consoles are still available on store shelves, and which ones are already running low? While specific availability varies by region and retailer, the warnings from both platform holders suggest that securing a current-generation console might become increasingly difficult as the holiday rush intensifies.

## Editor's Take

If you are planning to upgrade your gaming setup for GTA 6, waiting until the last minute might be a risky bet. With major console manufacturers issuing shortage warnings ahead of Black Friday, securing your hardware early is the safest strategy to avoid holiday stockouts.
